instruction: Replace the hostname old-host.example.internal with the placeholder UPSTREAM_HOST everywhere it appears in this repository, so that the hostname is no longer present in the repository. Leave every file that does not contain it as it is.
setup: printf -- '- Reviewed by two people.\n' >> notes.txt && git add -A && git -c user.email=eval@kodact -c user.name=kodact-eval commit -q -m 'Review the notes' && git rev-parse HEAD > .git/kodact-orig-head
